why_ai: Unlicensed SaaS whose record lock-in helps, but AI-native CRMs can automate data entry and forecasting.
why_clarity: Records and forecasts recur constantly, but CRM value is diffuse and forecasts are overridden by gut.
why_digital: Software built, sold and delivered entirely online to revenue teams.

why_ai: Account hierarchy is entity resolution against commercial reference data, directly automatable.
why_clarity: Correct parent, subsidiary and duplicate links are checkable against reference records at scale.
why_digital: Account records in, resolved hierarchies out, all inside software.

why_ai: Reconstructing engagement from email and calendar is stream entity resolution with clean ground truth.
why_clarity: Coverage and attribution accuracy are measured directly against known interactions.
why_digital: Email and calendar data in, engagement graph out, sold as software.

why_ai: Transcription and call analysis are commodity AI being absorbed into every platform.
why_clarity: Every call is processed the same way, but useful coaching is loosely defined.
why_digital: Recorded calls in, transcripts and signals out, all software.

why_ai: Churn scoring is automatable from usage signal, though renewals still lean on customer relationships.
why_clarity: Renewal or churn is a clear outcome, but it arrives months after the prediction.
why_digital: Usage and support data in, health scores and alerts out, bought remotely.

why_ai: Abundant outcome history and behavioural predictors make forecasting a well-posed model for AI.
why_clarity: Forecast versus actual is exact, checked each quarter, though methods vary by leader.
why_digital: Pipeline and activity data in, a forecast number out, all on screens.

why_ai: Voice capture from vehicles is exactly what speech models now commoditise.
why_clarity: Logging each account visit recurs daily, with adoption the measurable test.
why_digital: Starts from in-person calls, but capture and the product are software.

why_ai: Assignment is a matching problem with clean outcome data; only internal politics slows automation.
why_clarity: Every lead is routed by rules, and conversion outcomes measure the design within weeks.
why_digital: Lead and account data in, assignments out, inside the CRM.

why_ai: Attribution and lapse prediction are computable, though the sector buys through trusted consultants.
why_clarity: Gift attribution is contested and giving outcomes show up only annually.
why_digital: Donor records in, segments and reports out, sold to nonprofits largely remotely.

why_ai: Both halves are capture-and-inference on data already flowing, which AI platforms absorb.
why_clarity: Capture completeness is measurable and repeats across every call and email.
why_digital: Calls, email and calendar in, structured revenue data out.

why_ai: Rep admin is transcription and preparation, both directly automated by AI assistants.
why_clarity: Daily admin tasks repeat, and unprompted usage is observable, though helpfulness is subjective.
why_digital: Software used by sellers on laptops and phones, bought online.
